formal.scope: 完整返回标签包含无效周期，前端返回、窗口占用和卷积完成条件均允许任意组合。

mapping_scope: 缓存错误数组、前端写入有效、返回标签和仲裁器向量有效译码的实际源码表达式；输入和输出均寄存。

resources.counting_method: Each LUT primitive is counted once before packing; LUT RAM and SRL use their architectural LUT storage requirements. Packing may combine compatible logic LUTs or insert routing LUTs. A placed design supplies physical_lut_sites_after_placement.

response_error_to_vector_raw_valid.path_method: Connected bit graph from clocked storage to synchronous data/control inputs. Each LUT output follows its INIT truth table after binding constants and repeated signals; unknown truth tables retain all possible dependencies. CARRY4 dependencies follow carry direction, and asynchronous memory outputs depend on read addresses. DSP register parameters define clocked boundaries. Arithmetic between an input port and an internal register, between internal registers, or between an internal register and an output port contributes one DSP cell for that connected segment. Direct registered outputs contribute zero arithmetic cells. The identified ONE48 A:B/C ALU mode preserves low-to-high carry direction for P and PCOUT; all other DSP dependencies remain conservative, including the A:B ALU bypass. Counts describe structural depth; primitive and routing delays require device timing analysis.
